lesson.pre_a1_modelo: It is a vacation. It is not a business trip.

listenings.text: Hello again, everyone. This is the customs form. It is one form for one family. The form is not on the computer. It is on paper, so please use a pen. Write your address in the U.S. Are you a U.S. citizen? Then this form is not for you. Thank you.

Hi, I am Carol. I am from Chicago. I am not on vacation. This is a business trip. My family is not with me. My husband is at home with our two children. My hotel address is on my phone. I am tired, but I am happy.

extra_audio.text: Mark gives Eliane a form. The form asks: Are you a U.S. citizen? Eliane writes: No. The form asks: Is this a business trip? Eliane writes: No, it is a vacation.

the man you are married to

paras: Eliane is on the plane. It is one hour to Miami. Mark, the flight attendant, gives her a paper. It is the customs form. The form is in English, but it is not difficult. The questions are short.
Question one: Are you a U.S. citizen? No, she is not. She is from Brazil. Question two: Is this a business trip? No, it is not. It is a vacation. Eliane is not in Miami for work.

Question three: Is your family with you? Yes, it is. Her husband is on the plane too. Question four: What is your address in the U.S.? It is the family apartment in Miami. Eliane writes the answers with her pen. Her form is ready.
